answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted registration with social vouching: each agent must bond meaningful capital and be attested by long-lived, already-verified peers. A Sybil operator hiding like a sable among honest agents must split its stake across fake identities, so each one carries negligible influence; slashing then burns any ember of collusive vouching. Influence thus bends like a willow under attack but never breaks, making mass identity forgery economically pointless.
